name: llama.cpp PR #15550: quantize --target-bpw, arguing that same-named quants are not a controlled comparison because bpw differs
notes: Author's own argument for bpw-normalized comparison: two models quantized at 'the same Q4_K_M level' can end up at 4.75 and 4.30 bpw, making performance comparisons between models not a controlled experiment. Measurement-methodology evidence, not a bug.
